Open its Espionage view. If Establish Spy Network is offered, assign an envoy there.
Watch the intel and infiltration shown in game before choosing an operation; operation choices may depend on DLC and other conditions.

sources: Steam Guide 3829341385 (RedEye, 29 Oct 2026, 4.5.2) — verify exact caps and fees in installed defines
steps: Keep monthly Trade positive before expanding; Trade pays logistics upkeep, covers local colony resource deficits, and funds Market purchases.
Treat Market purchases as a short-term runway bridge because the base Market fee starts at 30%.
Watch storage caps (15,000 base per material resource, 50,000 Trade, 1,000 Influence) so surplus production is not wasted.
check: Confirm your current Market fee, storage caps, and local colony deficits in the in-game Economy and Market screens.

sources: Official Stellaris 4.5.0/4.5.2 Cygnus notes and Nomads DLC documentation
steps: Manage onboard colonies, Governors, and Captains directly on your Arkships rather than looking for fixed planets.
Survey systems and place Waystations to connect Waylines and sustain Operational Reserves; defend exposed Waystations from fauna and raiders.
Check Weapon Preferences (Arkships) and Defense Preferences (Waystations) in Policies instead of settled starbase policies.
check: Confirm Arkship slots, Wayline connectivity, and active Nomad policies in game.

sources: Stellaris 4.6 Corona Borealis & Willpower expansion notes — verify exact save fields in a 4.6 save
steps: Check your Fanatic Faction's approval, Ideological Momentum, and ongoing Influence cost before adopting or pushing an Ideology.
Expand Ideological Reach using Starbases, Ideological Beacons (and Hyper Relays if Overlord is active), and position Galactic Halls over key colonies.
For Gestalt empires with Willpower, review Gestalt Directives rather than standard pop factions.
check: Confirm Ideologies are enabled in this campaign's galaxy settings and verify current Momentum, Tenets, and Influence upkeep in game.
